info.name: Sitecore CDP REST Audit Events API

params.name: customerKey
params.description: The customer key identifying the Sitecore Discover account. Found in the Customer Engagement Console under Developer Resources > API Access.

params.name: key
params.description: URL-encoded JSON object containing event details

items.docs: Sends a behavioral event from a storefront visitor session to Sitecore Discover. Events are used to improve the relevance of search results and product recommendations. The key parameter contains a URL-encoded JSON object with the event details.

params.name: customerKey
params.description: The customer key identifying the Sitecore Discover account. Found in the Customer Engagement Console under Developer Resources > API Access.

items.docs: Sends one or more behavioral events from a storefront visitor session using a POST request body. Events are used to improve search and recommendation relevance over time.
